name: Klaven's Tower
summary: From a camp in Westfall, Agent Kearnen watches Klaven's Tower. Strange shipments and altered guards point to danger within the Defias Brotherhood.

sections.title: A Stakeout in Westfall
sections.body: At Westfall's southeastern edge, the river runs below Klaven's Tower, north of the Dagger Hills. The Defias Brotherhood holds the stone spire, though its human thieves and brigands are common across the plains. Agent Kearnen has watched the tower alone for weeks. Lately, she has seen strange things: a bizarre shipment came straight from Duskwood's shadowed woods, escorted by monstrous, deformed sentries unlike ordinary highwaymen.

sections.title: The Spire and the Spiked Guard
sections.body: Klaven Mortwake commands the tower, where altered sentries breathe in harsh, labored gasps. Among the shambling guards, a hulking zombie carries the Defias Tower Key. Taking it calls for silence and finesse. With the key, an operative can bypass the ground defenses, reach the stronghold's upper levels, and open the padlocked Duskwood Chest.

sections.title: Zanzil's Concoction
sections.body: Klaven Mortwake's personal journal links the Defias, the Venture Company, and the jungle trolls of Stranglethorn. It says the witch doctor Zanzil discovered an alchemical poison that raises unthinking, obedient undead drones. For Master Mathias Shaw and SI:7, this discovery reveals the Defias's widening ambitions. Their agents need a firm understanding of poisons.

faq.answer: Klaven's Tower rises near the river at Westfall's southeastern edge, north of the Dagger Hills. The Defias Brotherhood holds the fortified spire.

aliases: who is the rogue in westfall
faq.answer: Agent Kearnen serves Stormwind's intelligence service, SI:7. For weeks, she has watched Klaven's Tower in secret from a nearby camp, tracking strange shipments and planning an infiltration.

faq.q: What makes the guards at Klaven's Tower unusual?
faq.answer: The tower's sentries are altered undead, unlike the Defias's usual human bandits. An exotic alchemical concoction shipped into Westfall made them mindless laborers.

faq.q: How does the Defias have undead servants?
faq.answer: The Defias obtained a specialized toxic brew from Zanzil, a jungle troll witch doctor in Stranglethorn Vale. The poison came through dealings with the Venture Company and turns living subjects into obedient drones.
Klaven Mortwake is a high-ranking Defias overseer at the tower. He oversaw dark shipments from Duskwood and kept a private journal about their sinister alchemy.

faq.q: Why does Mathias Shaw care about the recovered journal?
faq.answer: Master Mathias Shaw needs useful intelligence on Defias alliances and dangerous foreign agents. Word that Zanzil's trolls can create undead through poison warns SI:7 of a grave threat to Stormwind. So the agency must train its operatives in venomcraft.

angles.text: As an Alliance rogue, you face a covert infiltration that calls for stealth, pickpocketing, lockpicking, and finding an enemy's physical weakness.
The Defias at Klaven's Tower have joined with jungle trolls and dark alchemy to threaten the kingdom. They are more than aggrieved masons.
As a human defender of Stormwind, you may be horrified to find former countrymen turned into mindless undead drones in Westfall.
